DeployBot: Pipeline for commit abcdef1 (tag v2.14.0) — env: staging — status: FAILED
- build: failed
- unit tests: 3 failed
- lint: 1 error
- integration: not run
Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/7654 :rotating_light:

alice: Ugh, saw this. Tests + lint together, looks like the recent lm-serving-core bump might be culprit. @bob can you grab logs? :eyes:

bob: Pulling logs now, starting with lint error.

bob: eslint: src/web/renderer.ts: "'unusedVar' is defined but never used."
```
src/web/renderer.ts:45:7 - error TS6133: 'unusedVar' is declared but its value is never read.
```

carol: FWIW the unit failures are in runtime cache tests:
```
tests/runtime/test_cache.py::test_kv_eviction FAILED - AssertionError: expected 2 got 3
```
Seems timing-sensitive after the cache refactor in lm-serving-core 1.4.0.

dave: Given two independent issues, I'd recommend holding canary and pinning lm-serving-core back to 1.3.2 in the requirements to unblock. Hotfix PR + run full CI?

alice: Agree with hold. Can we do a minimal pin or do a revert? Which is faster?

bob: Pin should be quickest. I'll open a PR that pins lm-serving-core==1.3.2, add a short rollback note to release notes, and trigger CI. ETA ~25m.

DeployBot: @bob triggered: re-run pipeline for commit abcdef1 (with PR patch) — build queued. https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/7656

qa-bot: Smoke tests queued once build completes. Please post PR link so I can watch.

bob: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/412 — pins lm-serving-core to 1.3.2, notes in changelog. CI running (build + unit + lint).

DeployBot: Build 7656 — build: PASSED, unit tests: PASSED, lint: FIXED (eslint error resolved by removing unused import) :tada:
Full run link: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/7656/results

alice: Nice work. We'll keep canary on hold until QA gives smoke green. If smoke passes, canary rollout with 1h monitor and rollback window.

carol: I'll run quick smoke locally and kick off canary smoke in staging. Reporting back in ~10m.

dave: Add note to release notes: "temporary pin of lm-serving-core due to cache refactor instability; follow-up upgrade planned after further regression tests."

alice: :thumbsup: Ping me when smoke is green so we can decide to proceed or extend the hold.
